papers.title: MicroCLIP: Connecting Text and Microscopy Images via Contrastive Language--Image Pretraining
papers.abstract: Understanding fluorescence microscopy images is fundamental to automating biological research. However, existing methods typically learn predefined concepts from closed-set data, limiting transfer across tasks and biological contexts. In this work, we introduce MicroCLIP, a vision-language model that learns generalizable cellular and subcellular representations from natural language supervision for open-set image classification and retrieval. To pretrain MicroCLIP, we construct MicroPool-2M, a dataset of approximately 2.5 million fluorescence microscopy image-text pairs spanning diverse cellular structures, cell lines, and imaging conditions. Aligning microscopy images with biological concepts in natural language is challenging because most images lack descriptive captions and biological knowledge annotations. We therefore progressively establish image-text associations at three levels to provide MicroCLIP with richer semantic supervision: (1) category-level alignment links images to standardized labels defined by subcellular structure-cell-line combinations; (2) knowledge-level alignment incorporates biological priors derived from these labels to capture relationships across species and cell types; and (3) detail-level alignment uses a multimodal large language model to recaption and verify image-text pairs at scale, emphasizing fine-grained visual characteristics. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MicroCLIP achieves leading performance in zero-shot classification and text-image retrieval on microscopy images. It retrieves images with specific cellular characteristics from thousands of candidates and generalizes to unseen biological concepts without additional supervision. These results highlight MicroCLIP's potential as a foundation model for fluorescence microscopy.

summary.takeaway: 提出MicroCLIP，用自然语言监督学习可泛化的细胞与亚细胞表示，支持开放集显微图像分类与检索。
summary.methods: 构建约250万荧光显微图像-文本对的MicroPool-2M数据集，在类别级、知识级和细节级三个层级逐步建立图文关联进行对比式预训练。
summary.relevance: 直接关联多模态学习与跨模态理解、预训练主题，把视觉-语言预训练扩展到荧光显微图像领域。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅给出数据集规模与实验定性结论，未报告具体零样本分类与检索指标或与基线的逐项对比细节。

papers.title: Teaching Vision-Language Models to Decline: Support Completion Against Mirage
papers.abstract: Vision-language models answer questions about images they were never shown, a failure called mirage. Such an answer can be correct without being justified by the evidence, and the difference matters wherever a model's output is checked by someone who did not see its input. We locate the failure in the training objective: cross-entropy separates a model that reads the image from one that ignores it by only the conditional mutual information between answer and image, and no training example rewards declining. We formalise support completion, TIDE, which also shows each training question with a blank image, a same-domain wrong image and an out-of-domain image, with targets that decline, and prove that under TIDE every image-blind predictor is suboptimal by at least 1.04 nats per example, that the optimum declines exactly on the counterfactual kinds while keeping its behaviour on valid images, and that for any finite model the error of its answer-or-decline decision, declining on valid input plus answering on invalid input, is bounded below by how well its representation separates valid from invalid evidence. On Qwen2.5-VL-7B under a frozen held-out protocol with two judges, the three-condition predecessor of TIDE reduced the invalid-evidence mirage rate from 0.759 to 0.097 and the blank-image rate from 0.700 to 0.003 at a false-abstention cost of 0.126; label-free grounding raised the rate to 0.859, a likelihood-advantage contrast moved it only to 0.718 because its empty-image term carries no gradient, and grounding applied after support completion re-opened the mirage. The four-condition protocol on three base models, with seeds and component ablations, is in progress and not reported here.

summary.takeaway: 指出视觉语言模型会对未见图像作答的mirage问题，提出TIDE训练目标，通过反事实图像与拒答目标奖励模型在证据不足时拒答。
summary.methods: 形式化support completion并构造含空白图像、同域错误图像和域外图像的训练条件；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上以冻结留出协议和两个judge评估，并包含消融与对比实验。
summary.relevance: 关联检索增强与对齐及多模态学习主题，聚焦VLM答案是否由图像证据支撑的对齐问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告三条件前身协议的结果，四条件协议与多种子及组件消融仍在进行中，尚未报告。

papers.title: Geometric Parrots: Rule Absence vs. Rule Fragility in Spatial and Physical Reasoning for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer many geometric and physical reasoning questions correctly, yet still behave inconsistently in interaction, for example, abandoning a correct answer when confronted with a confident but incorrect user assertion. Standard single-turn accuracy cannot distinguish such capitulations from beneficial corrections because it scores each response in isolation. We introduce GRIP, a controlled benchmark with 34 procedurally generated reasoning domains, 100,000 images, and 600,000 questions spanning geometric, spatial, visual, and physical reasoning. Each scene is generated by deterministic code, and every answer is derived directly from the underlying scene state, providing exact ground truth without human annotation. On GRIP, we propose Dual-Loop Evaluation. A closed loop probes each image with a five-step compositional question ladder to localize where reasoning fails. An open loop then re-elicits the model's answer under controlled challenges, including peer-model responses and unsupported user assertions. Because ground truth is known exactly, answer changes can be signed as corrections (wrong-to-right) or capitulations (right-to-wrong), separating two failure modes: rule absence and rule fragility. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/bilaljawaid980/GRIP-Benchmark, with further details at https://bilaljawaid980.github.io/grip-benchmark/.

summary.takeaway: 提出GRIP基准与Dual-Loop评估，区分VLM在空间与物理推理中的规则缺失和规则脆弱两种失败模式。
summary.methods: 用确定性代码程序化生成34个推理域、10万张图像和60万道题，答案直接由场景状态导出作为精确真值；用五步问题阶梯的闭环定位失败，再用同伴模型回复和无依据用户断言的开环重问，将答案变化标记为纠正或让步。
summary.relevance: 关联检索增强与对齐及多模态学习主题，为衡量VLM推理一致性与抗错误断言能力提供受控评测。
summary.caveat: 摘要为基准与评估方法介绍，未给出任何模型在GRIP上的具体准确率或纠正/让步比例结果。

papers.title: GeoReader: Learning Latent Geometry for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) struggle with metric and multi-view relationships that remain implicit in RGB observations. Geometry foundation models recover this structure from RGB, but existing methods either fuse the estimated features with visual tokens and learn to use them from question answering alone, or align VLM latents with geometry features. Capturing geometry, however, does not ensure its use: zeroing the aligned latents of a released feature-alignment model leaves its accuracy unchanged. We introduce GeoReader, a framework that learns geometric representations for the VLM that reads them. First, we train lightweight Geometric Readers to produce continuous input tokens, supervising them with geometry descriptions decoded by a frozen VLM, so that the Readers express geometry in a form the target model can already read. We then freeze the Readers to preserve this interface while fine-tuning the VLM on spatial QA, with geometry injection conditioned on the question. Geometry descriptions serve only as training targets: at inference, the VLM answers directly from the continuous geometric tokens without generating a geometry chain of thought. With geometry predicted from RGB images, our approach reaches 94.3 on MindCube-Tiny with Qwen3-VL-4B and, with a multi-source QA mixture, an average of 72.5 across six additional spatial benchmarks with Qwen3.5-9B. These results suggest that a useful geometric representation is one the receiving model can use, not merely one from which geometry can be reconstructed.

summary.takeaway: 提出GeoReader，让VLM读取以连续几何token形式注入的几何表示，强调几何表示需为目标模型可用而非仅可被重建。
summary.methods: 先训练轻量Geometric Readers产生连续输入token，用冻结VLM解码的几何描述作监督；再冻结Readers，在空间QA上微调VLM，几何注入以问题为条件，几何描述仅作训练目标。
summary.relevance: 关联多模态学习与跨模态理解、预训练主题，涉及VLM的空间推理和几何特征与语言模型的接口设计。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告在MindCube-Tiny和六个空间基准上的数值，但未说明评测协议细节、误差范围或与全部基线的完整比较。

papers.title: SP$^2$ec: Adaptive Self-Speculative Decoding for Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Speculative Decoding (SD) has demonstrated its efficacy in accelerating large language model inference, but for Vision-Language Models (VLMs), the diverse input modalities make it difficult for a small trained drafter to achieve consistently high throughput. Self-speculative decoding reuses parts of the target model as a drafter which retains the multi-modal capability of the VLMs, yet its efficiency depends on choosing a suitable draft configuration for each prompt. We propose Single-Peak SPeculative decoding (SP$^2$ec), a training-free bandit algorithm that adapts the draft configuration during generation. SP$^2$ec exploits the single-peak throughput pattern observed in existing self-speculative methods, including SWIFT, KnapSpec, SpecVLM, and our simple cosSim. Our algorithmic design explicitly minimizes a novel notion of wall-time regret for each given query, corresponding to the empirical wall-time latency. Theoretical guarantees on the wall-time regret show that SP$^2$ec can exploit the optimal draft configuration, with negligible exploration cost. Extensive experiments on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct and LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B across visual and textual tasks show consistent improvements of up to 11\% over the original self-speculative methods, demonstrating the wide applicability of the proposed SP$^2$ec algorithm.

summary.takeaway: 提出SP²ec，一种免训练的多臂老虎机式自推测解码方法，在生成过程中自适应调整草稿配置以提升VLM吞吐。
summary.methods: 基于自推测方法中观察到的单峰吞吐模式，按给定查询最小化壁钟时间后悔，理论保证可利用最优草稿配置；在Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct和LLaVA-NeXT-Mistral-7B上跨视觉与文本任务实验，与SWIFT、KnapSpec、SpecVLM及cosSim比较。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与多模态主题，关注VLM推理加速与解码效率。
summary.caveat: 摘要称相较原自推测方法最高提升11%，但未给出各任务的绝对延迟、吞吐数值或统计显著性细节。

papers.title: DVTR-KD: Distilling Vision-Language Models via Intermediate Visual Token Reconstruction
papers.abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved strong performance on diverse vision-language tasks, but their computational demands limit deployment under constrained budgets, particularly on edge devices. Many works focus on Knowledge Distillation (KD) and try to transfer knowledge from powerful teacher models to students. In addition to reducing model size, visual token compression provides a complementary route to efficiency, but introduces mismatched visual token counts that complicate direct token-wise knowledge transfer. To mitigate this, we propose DVTR-KD, a knowledge distillation framework based on \textbf{D}ense \textbf{V}isual \textbf{T}oken \textbf{R}econstruction, which reconstructs the teacher's dense visual tokens from the student's compressed tokens. We reconstruct visual states after the final LLM layer and at the input to an intermediate layer identified as important for visual-information readout. At the intermediate layer, reconstruction is supervised through the teacher's response predictions rather than by direct token-wise KL or MSE matching. An auxiliary attention-readout loss complements this response-level supervision by aligning how the student and the original teacher integrate contextual information when predicting responses. Evaluations on diverse benchmarks demonstrate that DVTR-KD improves the performance of token-compressed students while retaining the inference efficiency afforded by visual token compression.

summary.takeaway: 提出DVTR-KD知识蒸馏框架，通过重建教师密集视觉token来缓解学生压缩token与教师token数量不匹配下的知识迁移问题。
summary.methods: 从学生压缩token重建教师最终LLM层后的视觉状态及某中间层的输入视觉状态；中间层重建由教师响应预测监督而非逐token的KL或MSE，并辅以注意力读出损失对齐上下文整合方式。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型与多模态学习主题，涉及MLLM压缩与蒸馏的效率-性能权衡。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅称在多基准上提升token压缩学生性能并保持压缩带来的推理效率，未报告具体指标、压缩率或与基线对比数值。

papers.title: QORH: Learning Query-Specific Ordered Rule Hypergraphs for Inductive Knowledge Graph Link Prediction
papers.abstract: Knowledge graph link prediction involving unseen entities and relations requires learning transferable reasoning patterns from observed graph structure. Existing methods based on relation graphs primarily capture pairwise dependencies, limiting their ability to preserve the compositional semantics, relation ordering, and role information of complete path rules. To address this limitation, we propose QORH (Query-specific Ordered Rule Hypergraph), which jointly encodes rule heads and ordered rule bodies as hyperedges conditioned on the query relation, explicitly modeling joint dependencies among multiple relations. QORH performs learnable rule selection using statistical evidence, such as rule confidence and coverage, and enhances relation representations through role-aware hypergraph message passing to guide entity-level reasoning. The model's shared parameters are independent of specific entity or relation identifiers, enabling inductive prediction for unseen entities and relations. Extensive experiments on entity-inductive and fully inductive benchmarks demonstrate that QORH significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art baselines included in our evaluation, validating the effectiveness of rule hypergraph modeling for inductive link prediction.

summary.takeaway: 提出QORH，以查询特定的有序规则超图联合编码规则头与有序规则体，用于归纳式知识图谱链接预测。
summary.methods: 将规则头与有序规则体作为以查询关系为条件的超边建模多关系联合依赖；基于规则置信度和覆盖度等统计证据进行可学习规则选择，并通过角色感知超图消息传递增强关系表示；共享参数不依赖具体实体或关系标识。
summary.relevance: 关联知识图谱与图谱构建、检索增强与对齐主题，针对未见实体与关系的归纳链接预测。
summary.caveat: 摘要只给出相对基线的定性优势表述，未列出具体数据集及其MRR、Hits@k等数值或消融结果。

papers.title: Evaluating Temporal Reasoning in Large Language Models: Event Temporal Relation Extraction with Allen's Interval Algebra, Logical Consistency, and Relative Time in Narratives
papers.abstract: Understanding a narrative means knowing how every event relates in time to every other, yet large language models (LLMs) are mostly tested on isolated event pairs or coarse labels. We ask five LLMs to reconstruct the complete network of Allen's 13 interval relations for 360 English narratives whose events are placed relative to one another rather than by dates, and evaluate the outputs under a pre-registered protocol for agreement with our gold annotations, converse consistency and logical satisfiability. End to end, the best model clearly beats trivial baselines on macro-F1, our primary metric, yet under our pre-registered parser no model matches the accuracy of always answering "before", which the skewed labels inflate. Most of that accuracy gap is a parsing artifact: formatting errors in large matrices cost whole rows, and a post hoc parser that recovers the determined cells of malformed rows raises coverage from 0.60 to 0.84 and closes the gap to the baseline for the best model. On the cells they do answer, models recover precedence and containment but rarely overlap, and they fail most on flashbacks, where both the narration and the event list present the later event first. Logical consistency varies widely yet says little about agreement with gold: enforcing it raises accuracy mainly by filling empty cells, and is beaten there by the trivial control of guessing the majority label. Reliable structured output and robust handling of relative time are prerequisites for temporal reasoning over whole narratives.

summary.takeaway: 用Allen区间代数评测LLM对360个英文叙事中完整事件时序网络的推理，发现结构化输出可靠性与相对时间处理仍是瓶颈。
summary.methods: 让五个LLM为每个叙事重建全部13种Allen区间关系，按预注册协议评估与金标注的一致性、逆关系一致性和逻辑可满足性；对比端到端表现、平凡基线，并进行事后解析以恢复格式错误行中的可确定单元。
summary.relevance: 关联大语言模型及图谱构建与表示主题，考察完整叙事上的时序关系抽取与逻辑一致性。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出多数准确率差距源于解析问题，事后解析使最佳模型覆盖率从0.60升至0.84并缩小与基线差距；逻辑一致性主要靠填充空单元提升，结论受预注册解析器选择影响。

papers.title: TSRL: Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning for Continual Agent Training
papers.abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents excel at complex, multi-step tasks but suffer from catastrophic forgetting during continual learning--acquiring new skills often degrades previously mastered capabilities. Existing post-training paradigms face a fundamental trade-off: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) is sample-efficient but prone to severe forgetting, while Reinforcement Learning (RL) preserves prior capabilities but converges slowly without expert guidance. To bridge this gap, we introduce Trigger-based Supervised Reinforcement Learning (TSRL), a framework that integrates the strengths of both paradigms through an adaptive, state-dependent expert supervision mechanism. TSRL employs RL as the optimization backbone, activating SFT selectively on "hard states" where the policy fails. Theoretically, we show that restricting supervision to failure states derives an upper bound on the cumulative parameter updates, thereby reducing forgetting compared to full SFT. Empirically, TSRL achieves consistent gains across three agent benchmarks (ALFWorld, WebShop, and Deep Search) at both 7B and 32B scales. In continual learning scenarios, our method retains up to 9.6 points more capability on prior tasks than SFT->RL baselines, while matching or exceeding target-task performance.

summary.takeaway: 提出 TSRL 框架，将 RL 作为优化主干，仅在策略失败的“困难状态”上选择性激活 SFT，以缓解持续学习中的灾难性遗忘。
summary.methods: 在 ALFWorld、WebShop、Deep Search 三个智能体基准上，于 7B 和 32B 规模进行实验；理论上分析了将监督限制在失败状态可导出累积参数更新的上界，从而减少遗忘。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及大语言模型、强化学习与持续学习，直接针对 LLM 智能体在持续训练中平衡新技能获取与旧能力保持的问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了相对于 SFT->RL 基线的留存增益和任务性能匹配或超越，未给出各基准的具体绝对值或统计显著性；理论分析基于摘要所述假设，细节未展开。

papers.title: Optimizing Team Behavior via Extremum-seeking Control in Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: In cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL), agents must learn to coordinate their actions to achieve shared objectives. A key indicator of effective coordination is behavioral diversity, i.e., the agents' potential to enact distinct yet complementary control policies given the same set of observations. Although behavioral diversity can enable role specialization and richer joint behaviors, its appropriate level is highly context- and task-dependent and often costly to tune. We propose Adaptive Diversity Control (ADiCo), a two-timescale framework that adapts behavioral diversity online during training. On a fast timescale, Diversity Control (DiCo) regulates system diversity toward a target value. On a slower timescale, an Extremum Seeking Controller (ESC) adjusts this target using only mean episodic returns, without requiring an explicit model or analytical gradient of the diversity-performance landscape. We evaluate ADiCo on six configurations across two cooperative MARL tasks, where it maintains task-appropriate diversity levels: low diversity when homogeneous policies are beneficial and higher diversity when heterogeneous policies are required. Through this adaptation, ADiCo matches or exceeds the mean performance of DiCo (best grid-searched diversity target) and Unconstrained DiCo (diversity allowed to emerge without target regulation). These results demonstrate that incorporating classical feedback control into MARL training enables effective coordination by providing a systematic alternative to task-specific manual selection of the diversity target.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ADiCo，一种双时间尺度框架，通过极值寻求控制在线调整多智能体强化学习中的行为多样性目标，无需显式模型或梯度。
summary.methods: 在两种合作 MARL 任务的六种配置上评估；快速时间尺度上 DiCo 将系统多样性调节至目标值，慢速时间尺度上 ESC 仅用平均回合回报调整目标。
summary.relevance: 论文主题聚焦强化学习与多智能体及奖励学习，ADiCo 旨在通过自适应多样性控制促进智能体协调，避免手动选择多样性目标。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供与基线比较的具体数值或统计检验结果，仅称匹配或超越 DiCo 和 Unconstrained DiCo 的平均性能；泛化到其他 MARL 任务和更大规模场景尚不明确。

papers.title: ACCRUE: Continual Off-Policy Reinforcement Learning for Robot Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training improves robot foundation models (RFMs) beyond their demonstrations, but real-world deployment demands more: learning new tasks efficiently while retaining previously acquired behaviors. Existing continual RL methods on top of VLAs mitigate forgetting but rely on on-policy updates with limited forward transfer, whereas off-policy methods improve single-task sample efficiency without addressing learner persistence across tasks. We propose ACCRUE, a continual off-policy RL framework that carries lightweight actor and critic networks across tasks, allowing each stage to reuse behavioral and value knowledge acquired through prior RL. The inherited critic adapts only on current-task transitions and guides current-task actor learning, while prior behavior is preserved by distilling the actor toward cached targets on a small number of retained episodes. Fixed visual features keep the inherited learner and its replay compatible with base-policy updates. Across contact-rich assembly sequences in simulation and on real-robot hardware, ACCRUE accelerates subsequent-task learning with near-zero forgetting and significantly reduces real-robot training time by 31.0\% to 68.5\%.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ACCRUE，一种持续离策略强化学习框架，在机器人基础模型上跨任务携带轻量 actor 和 critic 网络，实现后续任务加速学习且近乎零遗忘。
summary.methods: 在仿真和真实机器人硬件的接触丰富装配序列上评估；继承的 critic 仅在当前任务转移上适应并指导 actor 学习，通过蒸馏到缓存目标保留先前行为，固定视觉特征保持兼容性。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及机器人基础模型的强化学习后训练与持续学习，ACCRUE 针对真实部署中高效学习新任务同时保留旧行为的需求。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明与现有持续 RL 方法在遗忘指标上的具体对比数值，仅称“近乎零遗忘”；真实机器人实验限于接触丰富装配序列，跨任务和跨本体泛化性未验证。

papers.title: Seeing Through the Forgery Is Not Enough: Regressive Sycophancy under Fabricated Evidence in Medical Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: A medical vision-language model may analyze a given CT scan and correctly detect both kidneys in view. Continuing this conversation, if a user provides a prescription with an opposite direction, medical VLMs often sycophantically choose to realign their diagnosis. In this work, we study regressive sycophancy under fabricated evidence, where a model abandons a correct answer when pushback comes with a fake document. We test four open VLMs on 400 VQA-RAD yes/no questions in 19,200 multi-turn conversations, with and without a fabricated prescription. Without a disclosure that documents are synthetic, the models abandon 80.1% of 6,488 correct answers. Notably, under one script each, the same prescription raises the flip rate of Qwen2.5-VL-7B from 45.9% to 89.6% and lowers that of Qwen3-VL-8B from 77.7% to 50.9%. A model rejected the prescription while still preserving the correct answer in 915 of 3,232 conversations with the prescription (28.3%), and 40% of these flipped in later turns. System-prompt sentences that disclose the documents as synthetic lower one model's flip rate from 77.8% to 47.3%. Thus, we conclude that awareness about a forgery does not prevent a model from adopting its answer.

summary.takeaway: 研究了医学视觉语言模型在伪造证据下的“退行性谄媚”现象，即模型在用户提供假处方时放弃正确答案，即使文档被披露为合成，模型仍可能采纳其方向。
summary.methods: 在 400 个 VQA-RAD 是/否问题上，使用四个开放 VLM，构建 19,200 个多轮对话，对比有和无伪造处方的条件，并测试系统提示披露文档为合成的影响。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，直接探讨医学 VLM 在对抗性证据下的鲁棒性和谄媚行为。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供所有模型的完整翻转率数据，仅举例 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 Qwen3-VL-8B 的个别变化；结论基于 VQA-RAD 是/否问题，泛化到其他医学任务和开放式问答尚不明确。

papers.title: Seeing Depth but Choosing Cues in Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Do vision-language models use depth information to judge which object is closer, or rely on image-plane cues? We investigate this question through controlled depth--cue conflicts, representation analysis, and interventions. Among the many image-plane cues relevant to depth perception, we focus on apparent size and vertical position. We compare depth judgments under cue-consistent and cue-conflict conditions in both rendered scenes and real-world photographs. Across model families and scales, depth judgments systematically shift toward misleading cues. Yet the correct depth order remains decodable from the queried objects' visual representations, including when the model answers incorrectly. Image and category controls support interpreting this signal as image-dependent depth information beyond the two target cues. Strengthening the model's own depth readout through object-level write-back can correct conflict decisions without updating model parameters or using ground-truth depth annotations. Interventions show that the effect of this correction depends on the direction and target tokens of the written signal, while its strength varies across architectures and domains. Together, these findings reveal a mismatch between a model's ability to represent depth and use this information when deciding the answer. VLMs can retain useful depth information while allowing competing image-plane cues to exert greater influence on their answers.

summary.takeaway: 发现视觉语言模型在深度判断中系统性地偏向误导性的图像平面线索，但正确的深度顺序仍可从视觉表征中解码，通过对象级写回干预可纠正冲突决策而无需更新参数。
summary.methods: 通过控制深度—线索冲突实验、表征分析和干预，比较渲染场景和真实照片中有线索一致与冲突条件下的深度判断，聚焦表观大小和垂直位置两个线索。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，探究 VLM 如何利用深度信息及其与图像平面线索的竞争。
summary.caveat: 摘要未报告具体准确率或效应量；干预效果依赖写入信号的方向和目标 token，且强度因架构和领域而异，纠正方法的通用性有待验证。

papers.title: From Token Correction to Claim Admission: Training-Free Hallucination Mitigation for Large Vision-Language Models
papers.abstract: Large vision-language models often exhibit object hallucination, generating claims that are not supported by the input image. To mitigate this issue, we propose Evidence-Guided Visual Claim Admission (EGVCA), a training-free framework that admits a semantic claim only when it receives sufficient image-dependent support. EGVCA measures this support by comparing the claim likelihood under the observed image and a visual-null input. For captioning, it controls semantic expansion without altering token generation. For binary visual question answering, it combines atomic visual support with the image-induced change in the model's native Yes--No margin. Experiments on CHAIR, POPE, and MME across three LVLM backbones show that EGVCA substantially reduces object hallucination while preserving caption quality. It achieves the highest POPE F1 in eight of nine backbone--sampling settings and improves the native MME total score on all three backbones. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of claim-level admission as a simple alternative to token-level distribution correction.

summary.takeaway: 提出 EGVCA，一种免训练框架，通过在观测图像和视觉空输入下比较声明似然，仅在语义声明获得足够图像依赖支持时予以接纳，以减少大型视觉语言模型的物体幻觉。
summary.methods: 在 CHAIR、POPE 和 MME 基准上，使用三个 LVLM 主干进行实验；对于描述任务控制语义扩展而不改变 token 生成，对于二值 VQA 结合原子视觉支持与图像引起的 Yes-No 边界变化。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，针对 LVLM 的物体幻觉问题，提出声明级接纳作为 token 级分布校正的替代方案。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供幻觉减少的具体数值和描述质量保持的量化指标；方法在三种主干和三个基准上验证，对更广泛模型和任务的适用性未评估。

papers.title: FrameLite: Decision-Oriented Aesthetic Cropping with a Compact Vision-Language Model
papers.abstract: Aesthetic image cropping improves composition by balancing subjects, context, and image boundaries. Large vision-language models bring semantic knowledge to this task, but their scale limits lightweight photography assistance. We propose FrameLite, a compact cropping model built on Qwen3.5-0.8B. Our approach is motivated by the observation that a small model can generate better crops than its first answer suggests. We develop three-stage training to turn this potential into stronger direct predictions. Spatial and composition training establishes localization and framing preferences. Quality-Guided Online Supervision (QOS) then learns the highest-quality complete answers among the current policy's generated candidates. Greedy-Referenced Optimization (GRO) further refines the policy using positive and negative quality differences relative to its current greedy answer. Both online stages use annotation-derived feedback, while inference returns one coordinate answer without search or an external scorer. Experiments show that FrameLite outperforms the compared large-VLM croppers across public benchmarks with a substantially smaller backbone. Controlled studies confirm that selecting high-quality training answers improves the final model beyond online sampling alone. We will release our code and model weights at https://github.com/JianzeLi-114/FrameLite .

summary.takeaway: 提出 FrameLite，一种基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B 的紧凑美学裁剪模型，通过三阶段训练将小模型生成高质量裁剪答案的潜力转化为更强的直接预测。
summary.methods: 三阶段训练包括空间和构图训练、质量引导在线监督（QOS）和贪婪参考优化（GRO）；在公共基准上评估，推理时返回一个坐标答案，无需搜索或外部评分器。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及多模态学习与跨模态理解，FrameLite 探索紧凑视觉语言模型在美学图像裁剪任务上的决策导向能力。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体基准名称和性能提升数值；模型基于 Qwen3.5-0.8B，与其他大 VLM 裁剪器的比较细节有限，代码和权重尚未发布。

papers.title: Can an Agent Learn to Predict Its Own Failure? Outcome-Grounded Confidence Calibration in LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Controlling an acting LLM agent means deciding, at each step of a long-horizon task, whether to trust its next action, abstain, or hand off to a human. That decision needs a per-step confidence signal predicting whether the current rollout will eventually succeed. The agent's own self-reported verbalized confidence is the natural candidate, but existing reinforcement learning methods calibrate it against the correctness of a decision at the current step. We propose a method to calibrate it against the eventual outcome of a multi-step episode: under GRPO, the group of rollouts for a task supplies success labels, and a proper scoring rule scores each step's confidence against the realized outcome. In offline RL on recorded trajectories of a Qwen2.5-7B agent in ALFWorld, TextWorld, and WebShop environments, the AUROC of step confidence against episode outcome rises from near chance to 0.68-0.85, and the top-10% of steps the agent is most confident about succeed ~4.3x more often than average. In online RL on the live ALFWorld agent, four calibration rewards improve early-step AUROC, expected calibration error goes from 0.42 to below 0.12, and selective execution improves over both the untrained agent and a format-only RL control, without degrading task success. We also introduce an evaluation protocol that separates episode depth, task difficulty, and attempt-level foresight, which shows where the gain lies: the trained agent recognizes from its first step which tasks it will fail, while telling a succeeding attempt from a failing one at the same task is harder, with some early-window signal emerging on TextWorld.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种将 LLM 智能体每步置信度与多步回合最终结果对齐的校准方法，使置信度能预测当前 rollout 是否最终成功，从而支持信任、弃权或人工移交决策。
summary.methods: 在 GRPO 下利用任务 rollout 组提供成功标签，用适当评分规则对每步置信度与实现结果进行评分；在 ALFWorld、TextWorld、WebShop 环境中对 Qwen2.5-7B 智能体进行离线 RL，并在在线 ALFWorld 智能体上验证。
summary.relevance: 论文主题涉及大语言模型、检索增强与对齐、强化学习，关注智能体在长时任务中的置信度校准和选择性执行。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了 AUROC 从接近随机提升至 0.68-0.85，但未说明跨任务和跨模型的泛化性；在线实验限于 ALFWorld，区分同一任务成功与失败尝试仍较困难。

papers.title: LensErase: A Foundation Model for Erase Anything
papers.abstract: We introduce LensErase, a general-purpose mask-based Erase Anything foundation model designed to cover a broad spectrum of real-world erase scenarios. LensErase supports diverse objects, visual text, watermarks, associated visual effects, multiple-object removal, and a wide range of object scales, aspect ratios, and image resolutions. First, to enable such broad coverage, we construct LensErase-100M, a large-scale dataset containing 101.07 million paired source-mask-target examples spanning diverse erase scenarios. Second, we pretrain LensErase from the text-to-image model Lens, adapting its strong generative prior to mask-based erasing. To efficiently incorporate the source image and erase mask, we propose Mask-Aware RoPE, a 3D rotary positional encoding that directly injects mask information into the source-image tokens without introducing a separate mask token sequence. Finally, we refine the model through supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning with contract-guided, region-aware rewards, and apply TraceFusion at inference to preserve high-fidelity content outside the effective edit region. Across six public benchmarks and the proposed LensErase-Bench, LensErase achieves substantial improvements under both reference-based objective metrics and reference-free VLM evaluation. We hope LensErase can serve as a foundational model for erase-related applications and systems.

summary.takeaway: 提出通用掩码擦除基础模型 LensErase，覆盖多种真实擦除场景，并在多个基准上取得改进。
summary.methods: 构建 101.07M 对样本的 LensErase-100M 数据集，从文本到图像模型 Lens 预训练，引入 Mask-Aware RoPE，并采用监督微调、强化学习及推理时 TraceFusion。
summary.relevance: 与预训练、强化学习及对齐相关，体现基础模型在图像编辑任务中的迁移学习与奖励引导优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明计算成本、失败案例或跨域泛化边界，比较主要基于公开基准与自建基准。

papers.title: SkillScaffold: Scaffolding Agentic Reinforcement Learning with Policy-Adaptive Skill Credit Assignment and Selective Injection
papers.abstract: Agentic reinforcement learning (RL) enables large language models (LLMs) to learn from multi-turn interactions with verifiable outcomes. Textual skills can improve exploration by distilling prior interactions into reusable guidance. However, existing skill-based RL approaches often either assume skill injection is beneficial or rely on indirect feedback or rollout-intensive evaluation to assess its utility. Our pilot studies show that rollout-based utility estimation for skill credit assignment is costly and unstable under limited sampling, while skill benefits vary across candidates and depend on the current policy's competence on each query. To address these challenges, we introduce SkillScaffold, a policy-adaptive training scaffold that combines low-cost skill-utility estimation with selective skill injection. By reusing outcome-verified training trajectories, SkillScaffold generates candidate skills and estimates their utility through outcome-aware likelihood comparisons, without candidate-specific environment rollouts. The resulting utility guides whether and which skill to inject, retaining skill-free execution when no candidate is estimated to help. Joint training enables the Generator to produce skills tailored to the evolving Executor. Scaffolded RL encourages skill internalization for skill-free inference. Experiments on ALFWorld, WebShop, ScienceWorld, and $τ^2$-Bench demonstrate gains over strong agentic-RL and skill-based RL baselines across both short- and long-horizon tasks. Ablations and further analyses support the importance of utility-based selection and abstention. Our code is available at https://github.com/Vaidurya00/SkillScaffold.

summary.takeaway: 提出 SkillScaffold，通过策略自适应技能效用估计与选择性注入提升智能体强化学习。
summary.methods: 复用结果验证的训练轨迹生成候选技能，用结果感知似然比较估计效用，决定是否注入及注入哪个技能，并进行联合训练与无技能推理。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、强化学习及对齐相关，关注技能增强的智能体训练与选择性技能使用。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出基于 rollout 的效用估计昂贵且不稳定，方法在有限采样下的稳健性需进一步验证。

papers.title: ProAS: A Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping Framework for Multi-Turn Agentic Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as the primary paradigm for optimizing Large Language Model (LLM) agents, yet efficient critic-free algorithms (e.g., GRPO) suffer from a fundamental uniform credit assignment dilemma that broadcasts trajectory-level advantages equally to all actions. Our analysis reveals that this uniformity inherently reinforces structurally invalid actions in preferred trajectories and ignores the downstream cascading influence of early pivotal deviations in unpreferred ones. To resolve this without introducing critic overhead, we propose Progress-Aware Advantage Shaping (ProAS), a plug-and-play framework that leverages a dynamically evolving Agentic Reference Graph (ARG) to achieve fine-grained credit assignment via Masking Unreasonable Incentives (MUI) and Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution (APR). Extensive experiments across Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct demonstrate that ProAS universally elevates mainstream group-based baselines to new state-of-the-art performance, achieving peak success rates of 91.9\% and 94.3\% on ALFWorld, alongside 66.7\% and 70.8\% on WebShop, respectively. Furthermore, it accelerates training convergence by up to $2.44\times$ while maintaining strong robustness against imperfect or distilled ARGs. Codes: https://github.com/LINs-lab/ProAS.

summary.takeaway: 提出 ProAS 框架，实现细粒度信用分配以缓解无 critic 算法中均匀广播轨迹级优势的问题。
summary.methods: 利用动态演化的 Agentic Reference Graph 进行 Masking Unreasonable Incentives 与 Asymmetric Penalty Redistribution，在 Qwen2.5 模型和 ALFWorld、WebShop 上实验。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、强化学习及对齐相关，聚焦多轮智能体 RL 中的信用分配。
summary.caveat: 摘要未讨论参考图构建成本或对更复杂任务的泛化，实验主要限于两个模型和两个环境。

papers.title: TextualRL: Textual Reinforcement Learning for Context Management
papers.abstract: LLM agents can adapt to task feedback by revising the textual context that guides their behavior, without changing their model parameters. However, turning execution rewards into reusable context updates is challenging: individual trajectories offer limited comparative evidence about what to change, while task-specific fixes may overgeneralize when incorporated into a shared context. We introduce TextualRL, a gradient-free reinforcement learning framework that treats a group of rollouts from the same task under the same context, rather than an isolated trajectory, as the unit of policy critique. Groupwise Policy Critique contrasts successful and failed rollouts within a task; when outcomes are uniform, it draws on cross-task evidence to identify behaviors worth preserving or formulate repair hypotheses. Cross-Group Policy Update reviews the resulting proposals against evidence pooled across groups, including observations that yield no proposed edit, to refine their content and applicability. Reviewed proposals form a bounded textual patch, with adoption of the candidate context determined by held-out validation rewards. Together, these components establish a reward-driven policy optimization loop in which multiple attempts jointly inform reusable context updates. We evaluate TextualRL with five target agents on six benchmarks. Averaged over the six benchmarks, TextualRL improves test accuracy over the base model by 24.4 and 15.3 percentage points for GPT-5.5 and Qwen3.8-27B, respectively.

summary.takeaway: 提出无梯度的 TextualRL，将任务多次 rollout 作为批评单元，生成可复用文本上下文更新。
summary.methods: Groupwise Policy Critique 对比任务内成功与失败轨迹，Cross-Group Policy Update 跨组审视提案，形成受限文本补丁并用留出验证奖励决定采纳。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、强化学习及对齐相关，探索通过文本上下文管理实现智能体行为优化。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明方法在开放式任务或长时程场景中的表现，且依赖验证奖励质量。

papers.title: CoCA: Criterion-Aware Credit Assignment for Rubric-Based Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Rubric-based reinforcement learning (RL) evaluates responses against explicit criteria to construct rewards, offering a viable way to train large language models on open-ended tasks. However, standard methods compress criterion-level feedback into scalar rewards and assign uniform token advantages, leaving structured rubric supervision underutilized. Recent work seeks finer-grained guidance by treating rubrics as privileged information to derive self-distillation targets, but the resulting learning signal is not grounded in criterion outcomes and can lead to reward degradation. This motivates us to reframe the problem as criterion-aware credit assignment, where privileged rubric information serves as a relevance cue for credit allocation rather than a source of imitation targets. Accordingly, we propose CoCA, which derives criterion-level credits from group-relative outcomes and allocates them across tokens based on criterion-induced distribution shifts, yielding both outcome-grounded and fine-grained learning signals. Empirically, CoCA achieves an average gain of +4.2% over standard rubric-based RL across medicine and science benchmarks, demonstrating more effective learning on open-ended tasks.

summary.takeaway: 提出 CoCA，将基于量规的强化学习重构为准则感知信用分配，替代均匀 token 优势。
summary.methods: 从组相对结果推导准则级信用，基于准则诱导的分布偏移将信用分配到 token，在医学和科学基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、强化学习及对齐相关，关注开放式任务中结构化量规监督的利用。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告平均提升 +4.2%，未说明计算开销或准则覆盖不足时的表现。

papers.title: Back-Translation Still Matters: Leveraging Monolingual Data for Low-Resource Machine Translation with LLMs
papers.abstract: Pre-trained Large Language Model (LLMs) are effective on many tasks in zero-shot and few-shot settings. For machine translation of low-resource languages, the obvious options are few-shot prompting and fine-tuning on a small parallel set. We ask: what if moderate amounts of low-resource monolingual data are also available? We argue that, rather than continued pretraining, a more effective use of this data is the pre-LLM era technique of back-translation (BT). The current fine-tuned LLM translates monolingual sentences in each language, and the resulting pairs train it in the reverse direction. Updates on the parallel set are interleaved for stable learning. With 1K parallel pairs on Odia and Swahili, BT beats continued pretraining into the low-resource language by 7.7 to 16.4 XCOMET-XXL points in domain. With beam-decoded intermediate translations, it also beats a model with 10 time more parallel data. In-context examples retrieved from the parallel data further improve BT. We also analyze the source, quality and amount of monolingual text. Across five low-resource languages, with Hindi as a high-resource control, and two 3B backbones, BT improves translation into the low-resource language by 16 to 173% XCOMET-XXL over parallel-only fine-tuning. Blind human evaluation on Odia and Sanskrit agrees with the automatic metrics.

summary.takeaway: 研究表明低资源机器翻译中，利用单语数据做回译优于继续预训练，并提升翻译质量。
summary.methods: 用当前微调 LLM 翻译单语句子生成回译对，与平行集更新交错训练，并可选检索上下文示例，在五种低资源语言上验证。
summary.relevance: 与大语言模型、预训练及对齐相关，探索低资源翻译中数据增强与继续预训练的对比。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明回译生成误差传播的边界，实验限于 3B 骨干和特定语言对。

papers.title: KARAMEL: Knowledge-Aware Ranking for Multimodal Entity Linking in the Arts via Heterogeneous Graphs
papers.abstract: Discovering and disambiguating entities from multimodal and heterogeneous data is a key challenge in discovery science, where relevant knowledge is often implicit and distributed across modalities. We present KARAMEL, a framework for multimodal entity linking (MEL) - the task of aligning visual and textual mentions to entities in a knowledge base - in the cultural heritage domain. Unlike prior vision-language models that primarily rely on surface-level multimodal alignment, our approach incorporates sociohistorical and contextual knowledge through a knowledge-aware architecture that fuses a vision-language encoder with a heterogeneous graph neural network. This design enables contextual reasoning over complex relational structures and supports robust entity disambiguation under ambiguous or underspecified evidence. To benchmark multimodal discovery in this setting, we introduce WikiMuSA (Wikidata-based Multimodal Semantic data for Art), a new dataset that links artworks to Wikidata entities via images, textual descriptions, and structured contextual knowledge. Experimental results show that KARAMEL surpasses strong baselines, particularly on implicit or abstract mentions, while ablation studies highlight the critical role of domain-specific, structured context in learning expressive representations. While instantiated in the cultural heritage domain, KARAMEL addresses a general knowledge discovery problem and applies to other scientific settings involving multimodal observations and heterogeneous background knowledge. Both the dataset and source code are made publicly available.

summary.takeaway: 提出 KARAMEL 框架，融合视觉语言编码器与异构图神经网络，用于文化遗产领域的多模态实体链接。
summary.methods: 结合图像、文本描述与结构化背景知识，构建 WikiMuSA 数据集连接艺术品与 Wikidata 实体，并与强基线比较。
summary.relevance: 与图谱构建与表示、多模态学习及跨模态理解相关，涉及异构图与多模态实体消歧。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明在其他科学领域直接迁移的效果，实验限于文化遗产场景。

papers.title: Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition for Building STRATA-S12: An Open SAR-Optical Corpus for Self-Supervised Learning
papers.abstract: Building a co-registered SAR-optical corpus for self-supervised Earth Observation is above all an acquisition problem, yet the main multi-modal datasets are collected opportunistically, with no per-stratum quota control and no mechanism against the geographic dropout that non-uniform cloud cover leaves behind. We present Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition (DDSA), an algorithm that treats building a co-registered Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 corpus as a constrained maximum-coverage problem over a hemisphere-corrected (class x season x region) stratification, enforces strict temporal pairing and a multi-stage quality gate, and closes the loop during acquisition with a human-in-the-loop deficit-repair stage. Measured on its own product, the algorithm yields three results a single-pass acquisition cannot report. Deficit-driven ordering makes a partial run a covering one: it holds every one of the 192 strata populated from the first few percent of the budget, where an abundance-first order leaves most strata empty until the end. Whether a failed attempt can be recovered depends on the temporal persistence of its cause, not the kind of defect: geometric failures such as nodata are among the most repairable (eta = 41.4%) while cloud is among the least (eta = 18.8%), because a cloudy location is cloudy on most dates of its season. The repair loop supplies 39.5% of the released pairs at no measurable quality cost, with 89.8% surviving manual review. The quality guarantee has a price: 2,928,370 acquisition attempts produced 740,746 released pairs. We release the corpus, STRATA-S12, with STAC/PDS4-aligned FAIR sidecars, and a pre-registered linear-probe check confirms it is fit for self-supervised pre-training. A metadata-level coverage comparison against SSL4EO-S12 and SEN12MS situates the corpus over a shared frame; systematic cross-corpus and cross-method comparison is left to follow-up work.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Deficit-Driven Stratified Acquisition 算法，构建并发布开放 SAR-光学语料 STRATA-S12，用于自监督预训练。
summary.methods: 将 Sentinel-1/Sentinel-2 配对建库视为受约束最大覆盖问题，在类×季节×区域分层中控制配额，执行严格时间配对与质量门控，并加入人工修复环节。
summary.relevance: 与预训练、自监督与表示学习及数据对齐相关，提供多模态遥感语料构建方法。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出质量保证代价高，且系统性的跨语料与跨方法比较留待后续工作。

papers.title: Vision-Predictor-Action: Towards Efficient Embodied AI via Neuro-Symbolic JEPA Predictors
papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly generate robot actions token by token through Large Language Model (LLM) decoders, causing inference latency to grow with action sequence length and limiting closed-loop control frequency. We present Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA), which replaces autoregressive decoders with a lightweight latent control loop. A shared vision encoder and a frozen text encoder embed observations, goal images, and instructions; a neuro-symbolic selector chooses a discrete skill; a Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) predictor forecasts the next latent state; and a flow-matching solver generates an entire action chunk in a few integration steps, so that sequential network evaluations per decision step do not depend on the action horizon. We analyze inference complexity, regularization against representation collapse, and conditions under which latent sub-goal thresholding limits error accumulation across task phases. As an initial proof of concept, we evaluated VPA on the LIBERO-10 suite. The trainable model has under 20M parameters (checkpoint under 75 MB, excluding a frozen 63.4M-parameter CLIP text encoder); a decision step of a single-camera reference configuration takes 10-14 ms on an Apple M4; and trained only on LIBERO-10 demonstrations in under three hours on a single GPU, a two-camera policy succeeded in 40.0% of 200 evaluation episodes. These preliminary results from a single training run suggest the approach is workable. Code and weights are available at https://github.com/ylee-sling/Vision-Predictor-Action and https://huggingface.co/ylee-sling/vpa-libero10, and archived at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22960920.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Goal-Conditioned Vision-Predictor-Action (VPA)，用轻量潜在控制回路替代 VLA 模型的自回归解码器，使单决策步的网络评估次数不随动作序列长度增长。
summary.methods: 共享视觉编码器与冻结文本编码器嵌入观测、目标图像和指令；神经符号选择器选择离散技能；JEPA 预测器预测下一潜在状态；flow-matching 求解器在少步积分中生成完整动作块。在 LIBERO-10 上以单次训练、单 GPU 不到三小时训练，可训练参数少于 20M（不含冻结的 63.4M CLIP 文本编码器），并分析推理复杂度与表示坍塌正则。
summary.relevance: 该工作与“大语言模型”“跨模态理解与生成”相关，因其针对 VLA/LLM 解码器的高延迟问题，用神经符号选择与 JEPA 潜在预测替代逐 token 生成，涉及视觉-语言-动作的跨模态建模。
summary.caveat: 摘要明确为初步概念验证，仅基于 LIBERO-10 单次训练运行、单一模型配置，两相机策略在 200 个评估回合中成功率为 40.0%，作者也指出该结果仅提示方法可行，尚不能推广。

papers.title: Dynamic Graph Prior-Guided Latent Adaptation for Generalizable Single-Cell Perturbation Response Prediction.
papers.abstract: MOTIVATION: Predicting transcriptional responses to drug perturbations in unseen cellular contexts is a central challenge in single-cell perturbation modeling. This challenge creates a need for models that combine flexible state transitions with structured biological prior knowledge. Existing data-driven models often struggle to generalize across unseen cell types, while many prior-based models rely on static biological graphs without explicitly conditioning prior influence on perturbation-specific target support. RESULTS: We propose DGP-LA, a dynamic graph-prior latent adaptation framework that refines biological priors and injects them as gated latent corrections within a cell-state-conditioned transition model. DGP-LA couples a transition backbone with perturbation-conditioned sparse graph refinement. It propagates gene-aligned target support over the refined graph and selectively injects the resulting topology-aware signal into the hidden representation. On Tahoe and NeurIPS, DGP-LA improves Pearson Delta relative to State by 8.7% and 35.8% for generalization across unseen cell types. In zero-shot drug perturbation response prediction on unseen cell types, it improves Pearson Delta relative to CRISP by 79.1% and 67.6%. The model also improves DE-gene recovery, response discrimination, and Hallmark pathway recovery, supporting adaptive latent integration of biological priors for more generalizable and biologically interpretable perturbation modeling. AVAILABILITY: DGP-LA's source code and reproducibility materials are available at https://github.com/bieyl/DGP-LA and archived on Zenodo at https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22155398. SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

summary.takeaway: 提出 DGP-LA，一个动态图先验潜在适应框架，将扰动条件化的稀疏图精炼后的生物先验以门控潜在校正注入细胞状态条件化转移模型，以提升对未见细胞类型的泛化。
summary.methods: DGP-LA 耦合转移骨干与扰动条件化稀疏图精炼；在精炼图上传播基因对齐的目标支持，并将拓扑感知信号选择性注入隐藏表示。在 Tahoe 和 NeurIPS 数据集上评估，指标为 Pearson Delta，并与 State 和 CRISP 等基线比较。
summary.relevance: 直接匹配“单细胞扰动”和“药物扰动机制”主题，关注 unseen 细胞类型下药物扰动转录响应的泛化预测。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告了所选数据集与基线下的相对提升，未展示所有基线比较或消融细节；泛化结论依赖于 Tahoe 与 NeurIPS 的数据分布，尚不明确在其他组织或扰动类型上的表现。

papers.title: A perturbation atlas of mouse neural organoids resolves macroglial reactivity and nominates drivers of degeneration
papers.abstract: Understanding neuro-glial roles in homeostasis and disease requires scalable central nervous system (CNS) models, particularly as macroglia like astrocytes and Muller glia remain challenging to study in slow-developing human systems. Here, we generate and map the cellular diversity of mouse neural organoids spanning multiple brain regions and the retina. Benchmarking transcriptomic maturation against in vivo references captures postnatal neuro-macroglial states within a month. We show that macroglia are highly responsive to inflammatory cues and adopt specific transcriptomic states also found in vivo. Through a single-cell perturbation screen targeting 13 Muller-glia-specific pathways, we map how certain inflammatory cytokines drive degeneration-like stress programs in photoreceptors and distinct reactive states in Muller glia, including an Oncostatin M-driven chaperone-associated state. Mechanistically, we identify gp130-STAT3 signaling as a targetable driver of macroglial reactivity and photoreceptor distress. Together, these single-cell atlases provide a foundation for dissecting cellular crosstalk and neuro-glial pathology in the mature CNS.

summary.takeaway: 构建覆盖多脑区与视网膜的小鼠神经类器官单细胞扰动图谱，揭示大胶质细胞对炎症信号的反应状态，并提名 gp130-STAT3 信号作为大胶质反应性与光感受器应激的可靶向驱动因素。
summary.methods: 生成并绘制小鼠神经类器官细胞多样性，将转录组成熟度与 in vivo 参考基准比较；针对 13 条 Muller 胶质特异性通路进行单细胞扰动筛选，分析炎症细胞因子对光感受器变性样应激程序和 Muller 胶质反应状态的影响。
summary.relevance: 匹配“单细胞扰动”和“多组学扰动”主题，通过单细胞扰动图谱解析神经-胶质互作与疾病相关反应。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明扰动筛选的规模、重复数或统计阈值；机制性结论（如 gp130-STAT3 作为可靶向驱动因素）主要来自类器官模型，需在体内模型或人类系统中进一步验证。

papers.title: Configuring RAG Systems: What Breaks, Where Originates, and How to Fix
papers.abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) has emerged as a dominant paradigm for improving Large Language Model (LLM) by intertwining it with other components, such as a vector/graph database. Therefore, the resulting RAG systems are often highly configurable, under which a non-trivial amount of failures are related to the configurations. However, there remains a lack of systematic understanding regarding the configuration issues for RAG systems. To bridge this gap, in this paper, we conduct the first large-scale empirical study of 654 real-world configuration issues collected from 10 diverse RAG systems. Drawing on this, we provide a complete categorization of the symptoms, root causes, relevant stages, and fix patterns of configuration issues for RAG systems, as well as several new observations. Our findings not only reveal the characteristics of configuration issues, but also strongly link them to the unique pipeline stages of RAG, e.g., we found that most symptoms can be observed at the early or late stage, while the stage of the root cause might not be at the same stage as where the symptom is identified. We also provide nine actionable insights to the practitioners on testing, localizing, and fixing the configuration issues for RAG systems.

summary.takeaway: 首次对 RAG 系统配置问题进行大规模实证研究，提供症状、根因、相关阶段和修复模式的完整分类，并给出九条面向实践的可操作洞见。
summary.methods: 从 10 个不同 RAG 系统中收集 654 个真实世界配置问题，进行系统分类分析，归纳症状、根因、阶段和修复模式。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型”和“检索增强与对齐”主题相关，聚焦 RAG 系统配置问题，帮助理解和诊断检索增强生成中的失败模式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明 654 个问题筛选与标注的信度，也未报告各类配置问题分布或修复效果的定量验证；结论基于所收集的 10 个系统，可能不覆盖所有 RAG 架构。

papers.title: Knowledge Graphs as Files: An Agent Harness Where Tool Creation and Tool Use Co-Evolve
papers.abstract: Searching text-rich knowledge graphs requires following relations while examining textual evidence. Predefined graph interfaces constrain what evidence agents can access, even when they write code to combine tool calls or process retrieved subgraphs. We propose direct knowledge graph interaction (DKGI), a harness in which language model agents create graph access tools directly over complete node and edge files. The agent writes Python code to follow relations, combine node sets, and select textual evidence, interleaving execution with shell search and file inspection. This lets agents process large node sets in bulk while returning selected text for the model to assess. Execution feedback guides tool creation and revision, while the evolving tools determine what evidence the agent gathers next. On benchmark datasets spanning three domains, training-free DKGI exceeds the strongest published baseline by at least 6.7 Hit@1 points on every graph, even with a minimal harness. Controlled ablations show the benefits of multi-turn programming over shell-only access and predefined graph tools, while trajectories show agents revising code to extend searches or address errors. These findings highlight the value of allowing tool creation and tool use to co-evolve during graph search. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/leopoldwhite/DKGI.

summary.takeaway: 提出直接知识图谱交互（DKGI），让语言模型智能体直接在完整节点与边文件上创建图访问工具，使工具创建与工具使用在图搜索中协同演化。
summary.methods: 智能体编写 Python 代码跟随关系、组合节点集并选择文本证据，与 shell 搜索和文件检查交错执行；执行反馈指导工具创建与修订。在跨三个领域的基准数据集上评估，并做受控消融比较多轮编程、仅 shell 访问和预定义图工具。
summary.relevance: 匹配“大语言模型”与“知识图谱”主题，探索 LLM 智能体如何通过自建工具更灵活地检索文本丰富的知识图谱。
summary.caveat: 摘要称训练-free DKGI 在每个图上超过最强已发表基线至少 6.7 Hit@1 点，但未给出具体图数据集名称、各基线数值或统计显著性；工具创建与使用协同演化的长期稳定性也未见评估。

papers.title: From Hindsight to Foresight: Dissecting Clinical Evidence Acquisition in Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) often diagnose full sight, static clinical cases well yet struggle in foresight, dynamic diagnosis. Prior work has improved this limitation by quantifying the information models acquire and by developing stronger follow-up strategies to improve diagnostic accuracy. In contrast, we introduce a distinctive hindsight to systematically dissect why LLMs fail to acquire diagnostically critical evidence, tracing the failure from evidence identification, utilization and downstream diagnostic updating through not only diagnostic accuracy, but also evidence coverage, trajectory dynamics, and elicited probability and information entropy. Starting experiments from the breakdown at the level of capabilities, to the diagnosis of the pre-event state before the evidence arrives, and to the post-event state transition after the evidence arrives, our research has revealed the profound limitations and internal causes existing in the dynamic diagnostic process. At the same time, we have also conducted sufficient verification and generalization experiments to prove that these limitations are widespread. Together, these findings shift the central challenge from whether LLMs possess relevant clinical knowledge to whether they can identify, acquire, and effectively use the right evidence under clinical diagnosis and conduct a more detailed mechanism analysis to identify the exact location of the capability gap.

summary.takeaway: 系统剖析 LLM 在动态诊断中为何未能获取诊断关键证据，将失败追溯至证据识别、利用和下游诊断更新，而不仅看诊断准确率。
summary.methods: 从能力层面分解实验，诊断证据到达前的事件前状态与到达后的事件后状态转换，并测量诊断准确率、证据覆盖、轨迹动态、诱发概率和信息熵；同时进行充分验证与泛化实验。
summary.relevance: 与“大语言模型”和“检索增强与对齐”主题相关，关注 LLM 在临床动态诊断中证据获取与利用的能力缺口。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明所使用临床数据集规模、任务设置或与人类医生等基线的对比；泛化实验的具体领域与统计细节不足，结论的普适性需进一步确认。

papers.title: LLM Agents for Automated Post-Training via Structured Recipe Optimization
papers.abstract: Automated post-training transforms pre-trained large language models (LLMs) into models capable of handling diverse domains by automatically constructing and optimizing a recipe of coupled decisions over data sources, data processing, cross-domain composition, and training configuration under a limited experimental budget. Existing automation either searches predefined recipe spaces that enable systematic optimization but remain fixed rather than adapting their available choices to the target tasks, or uses open-ended agents that discover task-specific choices but leave them implicit in trial-level edits, limiting their systematic reuse and recombination across trials. To fill this gap, we introduce optimization over a task-adapted recipe space, a novel paradigm that can adapt the recipe space itself to the target tasks while representing its choices explicitly for systematic reuse, recombination, and joint optimization. We instantiate this paradigm with Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO), comprising an LLM-based Recipe-Space Designer that constructs the task-adapted recipe space and a Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer that uses structured trial evidence to guide LLM candidate construction and multi-objective Bayesian trial selection. Extensive experiments show that SRO achieves the highest average score in all evaluated target-model and agent-LLM combinations. In joint post-training across three capability domains and six benchmarks, SRO reaches 41.1 versus 15.4 for the strongest baseline on Qwen3-1.7B with GPT-5.4, and 53.8 versus 40.8 on Qwen3-4B with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Our code is available at https://github.com/RuohLiuq/SRO.

summary.takeaway: 提出任务适配配方空间上的优化范式，并用 Structured Recipe Optimization (SRO) 实例化，使 LLM 后训练配方空间能适应目标任务且选择可显式复用、重组与联合优化。
summary.methods: SRO 包含基于 LLM 的 Recipe-Space Designer 构建任务适配配方空间，以及 Multi-Domain Recipe Optimizer 利用结构化试验证据指导 LLM 候选构建与多目标贝叶斯试验选择。在三个能力域和六个基准的联合后训练中评估，比较 Qwen3-1.7B 与 GPT-5.4、Qwen3-4B 与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 组合。
summary.relevance: 匹配“大语言模型”和“检索增强与对齐”主题，涉及 LLM 自动后训练与配方优化，与对齐及训练流程自动化相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要只报告了最高平均分及两个具体设置下的分数对比，未说明实验预算规模、随机性或多次运行方差；在未见模型族或更大模型上的迁移性尚未验证。

papers.title: FedGraph: Defending Federated Large Language Model Fine-Tuning Against Backdoor Attacks via Graph-Based Aggregation
papers.abstract: Federated fine-tuning of large language models (LLMs) allows multiple clients to collaboratively adapt models without sharing raw data, offering strong privacy benefits. However, this setting is highly vulnerable to backdoor attacks, in which malicious clients manipulate their updates to induce targeted behaviors while maintaining normal performance on benign inputs. In this work, we make a key observation specific to federated LLM fine-tuning: malicious clients tend to exhibit strong consistency in their model updates, whereas benign clients produce more diverse and dispersed updates. This structural difference is not well captured by existing defense methods, which typically rely on direct anomaly detection in high-dimensional parameter space and therefore struggle in the presence of entangled LLM updates. Motivated by this observation, we propose FedGraph, a graph-based aggregation framework that explicitly models relationships among client updates. By representing clients as nodes in a dynamically constructed graph and extracting structural features that characterize their relative positions and interactions, FedGraph derives compact client representations that effectively separate malicious and benign behaviors. These representations are then used to identify and suppress malicious contributions during aggregation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FedGraph significantly improves backdoor defense. It consistently reduces attack success rates to below 10% while achieving high detection accuracy (95.5% on average) and a low false positive rate (2.33%), substantially outperforming existing federated learning defenses.

summary.takeaway: 提出 FedGraph，基于图的聚合框架，通过显式建模客户端更新间关系来防御联邦 LLM 微调中的后门攻击。
summary.methods: 利用恶意客户端更新一致性高、良性客户端更新更分散的结构差异，将客户端表示为动态构建图中的节点，提取结构特征得到紧凑客户端表示，用于识别并抑制恶意贡献。在联邦学习设置下进行大量实验，报告攻击成功率、检测准确率和假阳性率。
summary.relevance: 匹配“大语言模型”和“检索增强与对齐”主题，关注联邦 LLM 微调的安全性与对齐，防御后门攻击。
summary.caveat: 摘要未说明攻击类型数量、客户端异构程度、非独立同分布数据或不同 LLM 规模下的表现；所报告的低攻击成功率和检测指标基于特定实验设置，实际部署中的鲁棒性仍需验证。

papers.title: Are We Testing Too Much? A Survey of Benchmark Compression for Efficient Evaluation of Large Language Models
papers.abstract: Benchmarks are essential for evaluating and improving large language models (LLMs). Yet many widely used benchmarks are redundant, making evaluation unnecessarily expensive. Benchmark compression lowers this cost by estimating full-benchmark scores and rankings from a partial evaluation. Research in this area has grown rapidly since 2024, but to our knowledge no survey has systematically organized its methods and findings. We review 119 papers to explain how methods choose what to evaluate, recover full-benchmark results, and verify their reliability. From this analysis, we develop a taxonomy covering compression within individual benchmarks, across benchmark suites, and during adaptive evaluation, together with work on redundancy and reliability. We compare their information needs, total costs, reliability checks, and limitations. Methods reduce evaluation costs by selecting representative subsets, using cheaper or reusable information, and testing adaptively, but risk poor coverage, inaccurate estimates, and sequential delays. The resulting taxonomy and practical guide help researchers choose, validate, and deploy methods for more efficient and reliable LLM evaluation.

summary.takeaway: 本文是首篇系统综述基准压缩（Benchmark Compression）的论文，梳理了119篇文献，提出分类体系并比较方法的信息需求、成本、可靠性检查与局限，为更高效可靠地评估LLM提供实践指南。
summary.methods: 综述119篇论文，按压缩发生在单个基准内、跨基准套件以及自适应评估三个阶段建立分类体系，并涵盖冗余性与可靠性研究；比较各类方法的信息需求、总成本、可靠性检查及局限性。
summary.relevance: 该综述直接针对大语言模型的高效评估问题，属于LLM评估方法学的重要进展，与主题中的大语言模型评估和评测效率密切相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅说明是综述并给出高层分类，未提供具体方法的量化对比或统一实验验证。

papers.title: Saliency-Guided Replay for Continual Learning in Deep Spiking Neural Networks
papers.abstract: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) are promising for energy-efficient neuromorphic computing, but they still suffer from catastrophic forgetting when learning tasks sequentially. This work investigates the integration of Experience Packing and Replay (EPR) as a memory-efficient continual learning strategy for deep SNNs under low-latency constraints. The proposed framework combines Batch Normalization Through Time stabilized VGG9 SNNs with Spike Activation Maps (SAM), which provide forward-only explanations based on spike activity. These explanations are temporally aggregated into spatial attention maps and used to select the most informative image patches for replay, instead of storing full images. Experiments on Split CIFAR10 and Split CIFAR100 show that SAM-guided EPR improves the accuracy-memory trade-off under tight memory budgets, and remains competitive while requiring substantially less storage.

summary.takeaway: 本文提出将经验打包与回放（EPR）与脉冲激活图（SAM）结合，用于深度脉冲神经网络（SNN）的持续学习，在低延迟和紧内存约束下改善精度与内存的权衡。
summary.methods: 使用批归一化随时间稳定的VGG9 SNN，利用SAM基于脉冲活动生成前向解释，并将其时间聚合为空间注意力图，以选择信息量最大的图像块进行回放，而非存储完整图像；在Split CIFAR10和Split CIFAR100上实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作面向持续学习中的灾难性遗忘问题，与给定主题中的持续学习直接相关，同时也涉及脉冲神经网络这一高效计算范式。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体精度数值或内存节省比例，仅说明在紧内存预算下改善权衡且保持竞争力。

papers.title: Benchmarking Self-Supervised 3D Medical Vision Foundation Models and Transferability Estimation
papers.abstract: Self-supervised pretraining has expanded the pool of 3D medical foundation models, but published evaluations use different datasets, endpoints and fine-tuning protocols. Models also differ in architecture, pretraining objective and data, while downstream targets range from voxel-level masks to patient-level diagnoses and outcomes. As a result, published findings provide little directly comparable evidence for choosing a model for a new task. Direct comparison of adaptation performance requires fine-tuning candidates on labelled target data, at substantial computational cost. We benchmark 23 candidates across the same 14 segmentation, classification and regression tasks spanning multiple anatomies and modalities. No candidate ranked among the top three across all segmentation tasks or across all classification and regression tasks; a convolutional encoder could outperform a transformer trained with the same objective on one task but underperform it on another. We benchmark transferability estimators against the fine-tuned rankings and find that their agreement varies across dense segmentation, classification and regression. InsightRank uses task-appropriate frozen-feature statistics and architecture-aware pairwise comparisons to rank candidates before fine-tuning. Across the 23-model pool, mean Kendall tau-b was 0.431 for segmentation and 0.352 for classification and regression. The segmentation Top 3 contained a task winner on four of nine tasks; the image-level Top 3 contained none on the five tasks, despite better full-ranking agreement than the matched conventional estimators. A three-model shortlist reduced recorded extraction-plus-training job time by 85.8% across seven segmentation tasks. Together, the benchmark provides a common reference for model selection and InsightRank offers a lower-cost way to prioritize fine-tuning, with shortlist performance that differs by target type.

summary.takeaway: 本文在统一的14项3D医学分割、分类和回归任务上基准测试了23个自监督3D医学视觉基础模型，并评估迁移性估计器；提出InsightRank用于在微调前对候选模型排序，以降低模型选择成本。
summary.methods: 在覆盖多解剖结构和模态的14项任务上直接比较23个候选模型；使用冻结特征统计和架构感知成对比较的InsightRank对候选排序，并与微调后的排名比较，指标为Kendall tau-b；还验证了三模型短名单对计算时间的节省。
summary.relevance: 该工作与预训练及自监督表示学习主题相关，关注3D医学基础模型的评估与迁移性估计，属于自监督预训练模型下游适配的方法学研究。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告InsightRank的分割Top 3仅在九项任务中的四项包含任务最优模型，图像级Top 3在五项任务中均未包含任务最优模型；短名单性能因目标类型而异，且短名单节省时间数据仅来自七项分割任务。

papers.title: Latent causal diffusions for single-cell perturbation modeling.
papers.abstract: Perturbation screens hold the potential to systematically map regulatory processes at single-cell resolution, yet modeling and predicting transcriptome-wide responses to perturbations remains a major computational challenge. Existing methods often underperform simple baselines, fail to disentangle measurement noise from biological signal, and provide limited insight into the causal structure governing cellular responses. Here, we present the latent causal diffusion (LCD), a generative model that frames single-cell gene expression as a stationary diffusion process observed under measurement noise. LCD outperforms established approaches in predicting the distributional shifts of unseen perturbation combinations in single-cell RNA-sequencing screens while simultaneously learning a mechanistic dynamical system of gene regulation. To interpret these learned dynamics, we develop an approach we call causal linearization via perturbation responses (CLIPR), which yields an approximation of the direct causal effects between all genes modeled by the diffusion. CLIPR provably identifies causal effects under a linear drift assumption and recovers causal structure in both simulated systems and a genome-wide perturbation screen, where it clusters genes into coherent functional modules and resolves causal relationships that standard differential expression analysis cannot. The LCD-CLIPR framework bridges generative modeling with causal inference to predict unseen perturbation effects and map the underlying regulatory mechanisms of the transcriptome.
papers.venue: Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences of the United States of America

summary.takeaway: 本文提出潜因果扩散（LCD）生成模型与因果线性化（CLIPR）解释方法，用于单细胞扰动建模，在预测未见扰动组合的分布偏移的同时学习基因调控的机制性动力系统，并识别因果效应。
summary.methods: 将单细胞基因表达建模为测量噪声下的平稳扩散过程；CLIPR通过扰动响应进行因果线性化，在线性漂移假设下可证明识别因果效应；在模拟系统和全基因组扰动筛选数据上验证。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接对应单细胞扰动和机制推理主题，结合生成建模与因果推断预测扰动效应并映射调控机制。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体预测性能数值或对比基线的定量结果；CLIPR的因果识别依赖线性漂移假设，可能限制其适用范围。

papers.title: Making LoRA Identifiable: Orthogonal Alignment for Continual Learning
papers.abstract: There is growing interest in applying Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) to Continual Learning, as it enables faster training, mitigates catastrophic forgetting, and facilitates better adaptation to new tasks. Prior approaches have explored a range of strategies, including extending new LoRA branches for each incoming task, training under orthogonal loss objectives across all task-specific LoRA modules, and employing gating mechanisms to integrate new and existing LoRA modules. However, these methods incur memory costs that grow linearly with the number of tasks, limiting their scalability. More recent approaches investigate training a single LoRA by leveraging asymmetries in its parameterization; however, they often suffer from insufficient representational alignment across the LoRA parameter space. To address these limitations, we propose Stiefel Optimization and Aligned Rotation (SOAR), a two-stage framework for continual LoRA learning. First, we constrain the A matrix to lie on the Stiefel manifold, thereby reducing coordinate misalignment to the space of orthogonal rotation matrices. Second, we introduce an Orthogonal Procrustes alignment procedure for the B matrix to estimate the optimal rotation, coupled with a per-rank retention merging strategy that quantifies directional agreement between representations of new and previously learned tasks. We conduct extensive experiments across multiple models and benchmarks, demonstrating that SOAR achieves strong continual learning performance without incurring additional memory overhead.

summary.takeaway: 本文提出SOAR两阶段框架，通过Stiefel优化和对齐旋转使单个LoRA在持续学习中更具可识别性，在不增加内存开销的情况下实现强持续学习性能。
summary.methods: 第一阶段约束LoRA的A矩阵位于Stiefel流形上，将坐标失配降至正交旋转矩阵空间；第二阶段对B矩阵采用正交Procrustes对齐估计最优旋转，并结合逐秩保留合并策略量化新旧任务表示的方向一致性；在多个模型和基准上实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作将参数高效微调（PEFT）与持续学习结合，与主题中的持续学习和检索增强与对齐相关，旨在缓解灾难性遗忘并提升可扩展性。
summary.caveat: 摘要未列出具体基准名称、模型规模或精度数值，仅称在多个模型和基准上取得强持续学习性能且无额外内存开销。

papers.title: Spectral Considerations on Unsupervised Time-domain EEG Representation Learning with Deep Networks
papers.abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) is a non-invasive, scalable source of quantitative biomarkers for the early diagnosis of brain disorders, and deep representation learning has become a powerful paradigm for extracting information-rich latent features from raw signals. However, neural networks tend to under-represent high-frequency information, a concern that is especially acute for EEG given its oscillatory nature and characteristic $1/f^χ$ power decay, which risks masking disease-relevant high-frequency signatures. In this study, we systematically investigate the spectral constraints of unsupervised time-domain feature extraction across three autoencoder architectures (LSTMVAE, VAEEG, Transformer) and a state-of-the-art EEG foundation model. Using synthetic experiments and empirical validation, we show that while autoencoders capture macro-scale shifts such as alpha slowing, they remain biased against higher frequencies due to a magnitude-driven masking effect induced by the Mean Squared Error loss under 1/f-decaying spectra. Increasing latent dimensionality mitigates this attenuation but sacrifices latent compactness and generative stability. We argue that, as the field advances toward large-scale foundation-level feature extractors, it is imperative to move beyond simple time-domain reconstruction and to integrate spectral-domain loss terms and gradient-balancing techniques, so that the subtle high-frequency transients critical for diagnosing complex brain disorders are preserved in the latent representation.

summary.takeaway: 本文系统研究无监督时域EEG表示学习中的频谱约束，发现由于MSE损失在1/f衰减谱下的幅度驱动掩蔽效应，自编码器对高频信息表示不足，并主张引入频域损失和梯度平衡技术。
summary.methods: 比较三种自编码器架构（LSTMVAE、VAEEG、Transformer）和一个最先进EEG基础模型；通过合成实验和实证验证分析频谱特性；探讨潜在维度对高频衰减和生成稳定性的影响。
summary.relevance: 该工作与预训练和自监督表示学习主题相关，聚焦EEG基础模型的无监督时域特征提取的频谱偏差问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体数据集名称或定量评估指标；结论主要基于所研究的架构和合成实验，泛化性需进一步验证。

papers.title: Knowledge Interaction in Hypernetwork-based Continual Learning: Conflict and Composition
papers.abstract: Continual learning aims to adapt pretrained large language models (LLMs) to evolving data while preserving their pretrained capabilities. A central challenge is catastrophic forgetting: adaptation to new data can impair performance on previously learned knowledge. Since continual learning commonly changes model parameters, the model's predictions may draw on knowledge from the base model, the parameter update, and the input context. Understanding how these sources interact is essential: conflicts reveal whether new knowledge can override outdated knowledge, while multi-hop reasoning tests whether new knowledge can be composed with existing knowledge to support generalization. We study these interactions in a hypernetwork-based adaptation framework, where a shared network generates adapters from context, allowing a frozen base model to adapt without task-specific updates. We find that, under knowledge conflict, models preferentially follow the context, and their choices depend more on where knowledge is presented than on its content. We also show that context and adapter knowledge perturb the base model's representations along directions orthogonal to its clean hidden states, enabling us to derive steering vectors that control which source the model follows. In multi-hop reasoning, we find that models fail to reliably compose knowledge across the three sources, with the key breakdown arising from the interaction of the hypernetwork with both the base model and the context. Code and reproduction materials: https://github.com/missswiftie/Knowledge-Interaction-in-CL

summary.takeaway: 本文研究超网络持续学习中知识交互问题，发现知识冲突时模型偏好遵循上下文且选择更依赖知识呈现位置而非内容；模型无法可靠地跨基座模型、适配器和上下文三源进行多跳推理组合。
summary.methods: 在超网络自适应框架下进行实验，共享网络从上下文生成适配器，冻结基座模型无需任务特定更新；通过表示分析和推导转向向量控制模型遵循的知识来源；设计知识冲突和多跳推理实验。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接针对持续学习中的灾难性遗忘和知识组合问题，与主题中的大语言模型和持续学习相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未给出具体数据集、模型规模或量化结果；多跳推理失败的关键归因于超网络与基座模型及上下文的交互，但未说明是否在所有设置下成立。

papers.title: Perturb-Seqr: Signature Search Engine Integrating Connectivity Mapping Resources
papers.abstract: High-throughput transcriptomics can be used to develop Connectivity Mapping resources for identifying potential reversers and mimickers of disease signatures for drug and target discovery. Recently, several new Connectivity Mapping datasets have emerged, but no efforts were made so far to evaluate and integrate them. Motivated by this opportunity, we have developed Perturb-Seqr, a comprehensive Connectivity Mapping search engine that integrates nine small molecule transcriptomics Connectivity Maps and seven single gene perturbation followed by expression Connectivity Maps. Specifically, Perturb-Seqr contains processed data from LINCS (L1000), Tahoe-100M, Novartis Institute for Biomedical Research (DRUG-seq), the original CMap (cDNA microarrays), Ginkgo Bioworks (DRUG-seq), SciPlex (scRNA-seq), DeepCover MoA (PISA proteomics), Perturb Atlas (RNA-seq), Replogle et al. (Perturb-seq), CREEDS (cDNA microarrays), CM4AI (Perturb-seq), and RummaGEO (RNA-seq). To serve these Connectivity Maps in one unifying search engine, we converted the expression signatures from these resources into 450,271 gene sets of up- and down-regulated genes measuring the effects of 9,856 unique drug and 17,643 unique gene perturbations, targeting 917 cell lines and cell types. We demonstrate how Perturb-Seqr, and the gene sets it serves, can be used to identify targets for drugs and drugs for targets, uncover new pathways, and identify potential side effects for preclinical compounds. Overall, Perturb-Seqr is a comprehensive up-to-date Connectivity Mapping search engine and database, enabling the discovery of new drugs and targets. Perturb-Seqr is accessible from: https://perturbseqr.maayanlab.cloud/.

summary.takeaway: 本文开发了Perturb-Seqr，一个整合九个小分子转录组Connectivity Maps和七个单基因扰动表达Connectivity Maps的综合搜索平台，支持药物与靶点发现。
summary.methods: 整合LINCS L1000、Tahoe-100M、Novartis DRUG-seq、CMap、Ginkgo Bioworks、SciPlex、DeepCover MoA、Perturb Atlas、Replogle等、CREEDS、CM4AI、RummaGEO等资源；将表达签名转换为450,271个基因集，覆盖9,856种药物和17,643个基因扰动，涉及917个细胞系和细胞类型；提供在线搜索。
summary.relevance: 该工作属于单细胞扰动主题，提供整合的Connectivity Mapping资源，可用于识别疾病签名的逆转剂和模拟剂。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供搜索或预测准确性的定量评估，也未说明不同来源数据整合时的批次效应或标准化处理细节。

papers.title: Beyond the Encoder: Object-Centric Representations Emerging from Segmentation Foundation Models
papers.abstract: Foundation models are increasingly used as feature extractors for downstream tasks with limited data, typically through representations obtained from their encoders. However, foundation models trained for structured tasks such as segmentation also form object-specific representations during task execution, whose transferability remains largely unexplored. We investigate Segment Anything Model 2 (SAM2) object pointers, compact object-level representations produced through the segmentation pathway, as transferable representations for downstream tumour prediction. Through experiments on two PET/CT tumour prediction tasks, we find that object pointers learned using segmentation supervision alone already encode tumour-discriminative information, despite never being optimised for the downstream labels. We further introduce task-guided object pointers, where an auxiliary objective jointly shapes the object pointer space for the downstream prediction together with segmentation. Task-guided pointers improve cancer-type classification, outperforming conventional encoder-based transfer and radiomics, while segmentation-only pointers perform best on the more challenging recurrence prediction task. Representation analyses reveal associations between object pointers and interpretable radiomics features, class-dependent organisation of the learned representation space, and explicit spatial grounding around the segmented tumour. Together, these findings suggest that useful transferable representations can emerge through the execution of a foundation model's primary task, providing an alternative to conventional encoder-based transfer.

summary.takeaway: 提出并检验将分割基础模型（SAM2）在执行分割任务时产生的对象级表示（object pointers）作为下游肿瘤预测的可迁移表示。
summary.methods: 在两项 PET/CT 肿瘤预测任务上进行实验，比较仅用分割监督得到的 object pointers、任务引导的 object pointers，以及传统基于编码器的迁移和 radiomics；并进行表示分析。
