summary.relevance: 探讨基础模型预训练表示在有限数据下游任务中的迁移方式，属于预训练表示迁移主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告相对比较与定性发现，未提供具体数值或统计细节；任务引导指针在复发预测上不如仅分割指针，说明最优选择依赖任务。

papers.title: Keep Your Receipts: Trustworthy Cleanup of Agent-Built Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Agents build knowledge graphs as memory, and building them has become easy. Maintaining them has not. When a source is retracted, overruled, or erased, everything built on top of it (entity merges, entailed edges, community summaries) must be re-examined, and the maintainer must choose between deleting too much and too little. Deployed pipelines delete only the directly extracted facts: on our corpus that reduces contaminated queries from 32.2% to 28.0% under a real retraction and changes nothing under predicate revocation. Rebuilding is no repair for a constructor that samples: two builds of the same 300-document corpus differ in 29,475 artifacts, five times the 6,248 that removing the 61 retracted documents changes. PolyGraph instead asks the constructor for receipts: for every artifact, alternative bundles of source evidence, each claimed sufficient on its own, emitted in the call that creates it. Cleanup is then set arithmetic over the receipts, with no model calls. Because receipts are the model's own self-report, a re-derivation audit checks them by deleting the cited evidence and testing whether the constructor still produces the artifact. The audit finds that a receipt is trustworthy when it is shaped like the claim it backs. Merge receipts, each backing one narrow claim, agree with re-derivation 68% and 85% of the time. Summary receipts, elicited per sentence but stored as one flat list for the whole text, are wrong about two thirds of the time, almost always by keeping dead content. One receipt per sentence instead is 100% and 88% faithful and lets cleanup keep 33 of 35 touched summaries. The result holds under a second oracle model, a claim-blind prompt, ten further deletions, a second domain and a second constructor. Distrusting the summary layer cuts contaminated queries to 0.4% and 0.8% at 99.8 to 100% of the recall a perfect maintainer would return.

summary.takeaway: 提出 PolyGraph，通过让知识图谱构建器为每个产物提供证据‘收据’，实现无模型调用的可信清理，并发现收据形式应与所支持主张的形式匹配。
summary.methods: 在自建语料上比较直接删除与重建等清理策略，对收据进行重推导审计，并在第二个 oracle 模型、第二个领域和第二个构建器下验证。
summary.relevance: 针对智能体构建的知识图谱的维护与可信清理，属于知识图谱主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要报告了审计通过率等结果，但具体语料构成和通用性边界需查看原文；摘要方法未覆盖所有可能的知识图谱类型。

papers.title: Overcoming Catastrophic Forgetting: Continual Learning for Radar Waveform Classification
papers.abstract: Automated radar waveform recognition classifies the waveform and modulation type of a received signal. As new waveform variants appear over time, a deployed classifier must learn them without retraining from scratch. Catastrophic Forgetting occurs when learning new waveforms overwrites prior knowledge. Continual Learning (CL) methods tackle this challenge, but prior radar studies only evaluate a few methods on narrow benchmarks. Practitioners lack evidence on which method to deploy or which mechanisms are effective. This work presents the first large-scale benchmark of continual learning for radar waveform recognition. Eighteen CL methods are evaluated on a sequential ten-task problem, drawn from four public datasets spanning 54 waveforms, under task- and class-incremental (TIL, CIL) settings and single- and multi-epoch regimes. Methods that retain data from old tasks lead both TIL and CIL settings. Plain replay alone closes 77-88% of the gap between the lower and upper practical limits under TIL, but only 46-55% under CIL. The internal mechanisms of the leading methods are ablated and statistically tested to identify effective mechanisms. Each ablation is paired against its full method over n=6 training seeds, topped up to n=12 when inconclusive, and p-values are Holm-Bonferroni corrected within each method's family. Ablation results show that several mechanisms confer smaller but statistically significant gains. Combining these mechanisms improves the leading F1 score by 3.4-5.5% and 2.7-4.9% under TIL and CIL, respectively, and the combined models exceed every benchmarked method in both settings for all SNRs. These results give researchers of radar waveform classification systems a mechanism-level basis for design.

summary.takeaway: 首次对雷达波形识别中的持续学习方法进行大规模基准评测，并识别出有效机制，证明结合这些机制可提升领先 F1 分数。
summary.methods: 在来自四个公开数据集、覆盖 54 种波形的十个任务序列上评测 18 种持续学习方法，涵盖任务增量与类别增量设置以及单轮和多轮训练；对领先方法进行消融与统计检验。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题，针对雷达波形分类中的灾难性遗忘问题。
summary.caveat: 摘要指出仅用单一序列基准，结论是否适用于其他任务序列或真实部署环境尚不确定；消融增益虽显著但幅度较小。

papers.title: Data-Free Continual Learning for World Action Model with Rectified Generative Replay
papers.abstract: World action models (WAMs) built on pretrained video generation models adapt quickly to new robotic tasks, but they forget previously learned tasks under sequential fine-tuning. Experience replay (ER) mitigates such forgetting by rehearsing data of previous tasks, yet this data is often unavailable in robotics, where a policy is deployed as weights only and its training data is not shared along with it. In this work, we ask whether a WAM can achieve data-free continual learning by regenerating its own past. Our key observation is that a WAM can indeed autoregressively regenerate complete rollouts of previously learned tasks and replay them to mitigate forgetting. However, replaying such raw rollouts still lags far behind replaying real data, which we attribute to two issues. First, the WAM is unable to recognize task completion and keeps generating purposeless motion after the task is done. Second, under open-loop generation, the generated actions gradually drift away from the generated observations. To address both issues, we present rectified generative replay (R$^2$-WAM), which truncates generated rollouts at task completion with an agentic evaluator and filters out rollouts whose actions are physically inconsistent with the observations. On the four LIBERO suites and five real-world tasks, R$^2$-WAM reduces forgetting by over 90% relative to sequential fine-tuning and nearly matches ER without accessing any data from previous tasks. Our analysis further reveals that forgetting in WAMs concentrates in inverse dynamics modeling: a forgotten WAM still produces visually plausible observations of previous tasks while its generated actions fail.

summary.takeaway: 提出 R²-WAM，使世界动作模型在无旧任务数据条件下通过修正生成式回放实现持续学习，将遗忘降低超过 90%。
summary.methods: 利用 WAM 自回归重新生成旧任务 rollout，使用智能体评估器在任务完成处截断，并过滤动作与观测物理不一致的 rollout；在四个 LIBERO 套件和五个真实任务上评估。
summary.relevance: 属于持续学习主题，关注机器人世界动作模型的无数据回放。
summary.caveat: 摘要结论基于特定 WAM 和任务集，方法依赖生成模型能重放旧任务；未说明在开放环境中任务完成评估的可靠性。

papers.title: Ontology-Based Post-Coordinated Expression Assembly: from Clinical Narrative to Queryable Knowledge Graphs
papers.abstract: Clinical oncology documentation records decisive information in free text, where it remains readable but not retrievable at scale, leaving cohort identification dependent on incomplete diagnostic codes or manual review. The current standard, coding individual terms, captures what a document mentions, not what it asserts: meaning lies in how those terms relate to one another. We present a method for deriving queryable knowledge graphs from clinical narratives, conforming to the Extended Grammar of SNOMED CT across multiple ontologies. The method specifies how entities should be annotated and related. It defines five relation classes, each bound to a construction rule that assembles the entities and relations into post-coordinated expressions. A deterministic implementation, UNIGRAPHE, applies those rules to construct knowledge graphs from annotated text. Applied to expert-annotated real-world oncology documentation, UNIGRAPHE reconstructed 5,299 annotations into 2,196 post-coordinated expressions and shows that relation structure is the missing piece to make clinical narrative formally queryable.

summary.takeaway: 提出一种从临床叙述构建可查询知识图谱的方法，按 SNOMED CT 扩展语法定义五类关系及组装规则，并实现确定性工具 UNIGRAPHE。
summary.methods: 定义实体标注与关系构造规则，将注释重建为后协调表达式；在专家注释的真实肿瘤学文档上应用 UNIGRAPHE。
summary.relevance: 将临床文本转化为可查询知识图谱，属于知识图谱主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要仅报告在专家注释文档上的重建结果，未说明对未注释文本或跨机构数据的泛化能力。

papers.title: Effect of Spherical Parameter Space on Number of Non-Forgetting Tasks and Capacity of Continual Learning
papers.abstract: We propose a continuous learning formulation for $T$ non-forgetting tasks with the spherical parameter space $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ in asymptotic regime $d\rightarrow \infty$. Each task $i$ has an optimum $\bmΘ_i$, minimizing its corresponding loss function $R_i(\bm{w})$ on sphere. We reduce each task $i$ to an acceptable loss region modeled by a geodesic ball $B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$ on $\mathbb{S}^{d-1}(\sqrt{d})$ centered at $\bmΘ_i$ with radius $r_i(d)$. To model task dependencies (similarities), task optima $\bmΘ_i$ are distributed by a Neyman-Scott clustered point process $Φ$. Cluster centers $\{\bm{Y}_j\}_{j=1}^{N_p}$ form a homogeneous Poisson point process on sphere, while intra-cluster task optima follow a von Mises-Fisher distribution with mean $\bm{Y}_j$ and concentration $κ$. Each task $t\in \{1, ..., T\}$ learning algorithm is considered to be a channel $Q_{t}(\mathrm{d}\bm{w}_t | \bm{w}_{t-1}, \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmθ_{1:t-1}), \bmθ_t)$, where $\bm{W}_t$ is the learned parameter of task $t$ and $\mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})=\bigcap_{i=1}^{t-1}B_{\bmΘ_i}(r_i(d))$. Since in continual learning, the learner does not need to reach $\bmΘ_t$ exactly to successfully learn task $t$, to avoid forgetting as well as reliable learning, it only needs for the learned parameter vector $\bm{W}_{t}$ to enter $B_{\bmΘ_t}(r_t(d)) \cap \mathcal{K}_{t-1}(\bmΘ_{1:t-1})$. Using this model, we derive an upper bound on $T$ ensuring $\mathbb{P}[\mathcal{K}_{T}(\bmΘ_{1:T}) \neq \emptyset] \rightarrow 1$ as $d\rightarrow \infty$ and $κ/d \rightarrow α$, where $α>0$ is a constant. Finally, for $T$ tasks sampled uniformly from $Φ$, we derive an upper bound for total information theoretic capacity under the non-forgetting constraint for each task.

summary.takeaway: 在球面参数空间渐近框架下，推导出保证 T 个任务不遗忘的条件及信息论容量上界。
summary.methods: 将每个任务建模为球面上的测地球，任务最优值服从 Neyman-Scott 聚类点过程，学习算法视为信道；推导不遗忘概率趋于 1 时 T 的上界及总信息论容量上界。
summary.relevance: 持续学习理论分析，关注非遗忘任务数量与容量。
summary.caveat: 摘要为渐近理论结果，依赖球面参数空间和聚类点过程等建模假设，未提供实际算法或实验验证。

papers.title: Single-cell gene networks nominate IKZF1 as an Alzheimer's disease microglial regulator.
papers.abstract: BackgroundMicroglia drive neuroinflammation in Alzheimer's disease (AD), yet no approved therapy targets this compartment. Human genome-wide association studies consistently implicate innate immune loci in AD risk, establishing microglial transcriptional programs as therapeutically relevant but pharmacologically underexploited targets.ObjectiveWe sought to identify transcription factors (TFs) governing microglial state transitions computationally and to nominate structurally tractable drug repurposing candidates.MethodsWe applied trajectory inference (PAGA), pseudobulk DESeq2, pySCENIC gene regulatory network (GRN) inference, CellChat, and virtual screening of 1962 approved compounds to 236,002 microglial nuclei from 84 donors (SEA-AD atlas).ResultsIKZF1 was the sole target TF retained under cisTarget v10 motif constraints, with peak regulon activity in LateAD-DAM (pseudotime ρ = + 0.309) and replication in an independent bulk cohort (GSE95587; adjusted p = 0.004). CellChat identified SLIT2→ROBO2 from multiple neuron subtypes (predominantly inhibitory interneurons) as the top predicted pathway to microglia. Tafamidis (→IRF8) and diflunisal (→PPARG) were top virtual screening hits; all evaluated compounds failed the pre-specified selectivity threshold.ConclusionsIKZF1 is prioritized as a candidate late-disease microglial TF, supported by six convergent evidence dimensions including independent bulk replication. Tafamidis and diflunisal are low-confidence repurposing hypotheses requiring experimental validation.

summary.takeaway: 通过单细胞基因网络分析提名 IKZF1 为阿尔茨海默病小胶质细胞调控因子，并筛选出低置信度的药物重定位候选。
summary.methods: 对 SEA-AD 图谱中 236,002 个小胶质细胞核应用 PAGA、DESeq2、pySCENIC、CellChat，并对 1962 种已批准化合物进行虚拟筛选，另在独立 bulk 队列中复制。
summary.relevance: 涉及 GRN/Regulon 推断与转录因子调控网络，属于基因调控网络主题。
summary.caveat: 药物候选均未通过预设选择性阈值，属低置信度假设，需实验验证；IKZF1 的因果调控作用未在摘要中通过扰动实验证实。

papers.title: Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation: a framework for the faithful assessment of genetic perturbation target identification
papers.abstract: Identifying which gene drives a desired cell-state transition is a foundational inverse problem in target discovery and cell-state engineering, yet far less developed than forward prediction. We show that prevailing benchmarks inflate performance through two artefacts: training leakage, where test-perturbation cells are seen during fitting, and evaluation leakage, where the perturbed gene's own expression change exposes the answer. Here, we introduce Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation (CEE), a framework that separates train and test perturbation targets, removes target-gene self-effects from expression profiles and scores candidates in downstream response space. With CEE, we find that simple structure-based methods consistently outperform complex deep learning models across 16 single-cell perturbation datasets, revealing that the recoverable signal is governed by low-rank and additive structure in perturbation responses rather than by model complexity. Our work disentangles evaluation artefacts from genuine predictive capacity and offers a design principle for developing perturbation target identification methods.

summary.takeaway: 提出 Cause-excluded Effect Evaluation（CEE）框架，分离并消除训练泄漏与评估泄漏，发现简单结构方法在遗传扰动靶点识别上优于复杂深度学习模型。
summary.methods: 分离训练与测试扰动靶点，从表达谱中移除靶基因自身效应，并在下游响应空间评分候选；在 16 个单细胞扰动数据集上比较结构方法与深度学习模型。
summary.relevance: 针对单细胞扰动靶点识别，属于单细胞扰动主题。
summary.caveat: 摘要结论基于 16 个单细胞扰动数据集，未说明对更广泛扰动类型或体内数据的适用性；简单方法优于此处的深度模型可能受数据集特性影响。

papers.title: CloneOT: predicting clone-specific perturbation responses with lineage-supervised neural inverse optimal transport
papers.abstract: Predicting single-cell perturbation responses requires mapping between two unpaired populations of cells measured before and after the perturbation. Optimal transport (OT) provides a principled framework for constructing such mappings by minimizing the transport cost, and neural OT methods (\textit{e.g.}, CellOT) have been employed for this prediction task. However, these methods rely on a fixed transport cost, typically the squared Euclidean distance. This cost may connect cells with the wrong responses. Lineage tracing provides the information needed to learn the cost, as heritable barcodes link the cells of the same clone before and after the perturbation. Here, we propose \CloneOT, a neural inverse OT method that learns both the transport cost and the transport map from partially lineage-traced single-cell datasets. \CloneOT\ represents the cost as a neural network. It learns the cost by minimizing the extra cost that the lineage adds to the optimal transport, so that the cheapest transport keeps the cells of each clone together. Our experiments demonstrate that \CloneOT\ recovers the correct transport on 2D datasets, while the squared Euclidean cost fails. Moreover, \CloneOT\ outperforms five baselines on 14 lineage-tracing perturbation scenarios of cancer cells, for both seen and unseen clones. Furthermore, we show that \CloneOT\ reveals the clone-specific transcriptional programs of drug-tolerant persister cells and forecasts the fate of each clone from its cells before treatment. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/poseidonchan/CloneOT.

summary.takeaway: 提出CloneOT，一种神经逆最优传输方法，利用部分谱系追踪数据同时学习传输代价和传输映射，在单细胞扰动响应预测中优于固定代价方法，并能揭示克隆特异转录程序。
summary.methods: 基于神经逆最优传输，将传输代价表示为神经网络，通过最小化谱系对最优传输的额外代价来学习代价，使每个克隆的细胞在传输中保持在一起；在2D数据集和14个癌症细胞谱系追踪扰动场景中评估，并与五个基线比较。
summary.relevance: 该工作直接针对单细胞扰动响应预测问题，利用谱系追踪信息改进最优传输模型，与给定主题“单细胞扰动”高度相关。
summary.caveat: 摘要未提供具体性能数值、基线名称及统计显著性，且实验限于2D数据集和癌症细胞谱系追踪场景，泛化性需进一步验证。
